name: Schneider Electric President Systems Limited
about: Schneider Electric President Systems Limited designs, manufactures, and supplies standard and customized enclosure systems in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Nepal, Europe, Pacific, and North America. The company offers racks, enclosures, card frames, components and accessories, and electrical equipment. The company sells its products through a network of sales offices, representatives, and distributors. It serves IT/networking and ITES, telecom, and general and industrial electronics sectors. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as APW President Systems Limited and changed its name to Schneider Electric President Systems Limited in October 2013. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Bengaluru, India. Schneider Electric President Systems Limited operates as a subsidiary of Schneider Electric South East Asia (Hq) Pte Ltd.
